title: Law to require DOB sign-off reminders for property owners
summary: This bill would require the Department of Buildings to email property owners within 7 days of a permit's issuance about sign-off requirements, and to send follow-up notices every 90 days until sign-off, or every two weeks if the permit has expired or will soon expire. The notices must explain the permit number, expiration date, inspection access requirements, and the consequences of failing to obtain sign-off, such as fees and impacts on selling or financing the property. DOB would also have to publish an online resource guide on sign-off requirements.
